lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: You said you needed a fresh start. I said I knew a garage. I left out the part where it might be closing.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: We keep the lights on by fixing what other people gave up on. Cars. Mostly.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: Plattsburgh after dark. The river, the city, the coast. Eighteen chances to make a name.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: No shortcuts. No one owns your name. If you want a place here, we start tonight.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: You made it, {driver}. Same car, different city. Mara is waiting by the lift.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Quinn says you can drive. I need someone who can finish. Our garage lease expires at the end of the week.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Tonight starts small. Win the Ignition Run. Earn a place here before you try to save it.

capital_run_after.title: A NAME ON THE DOOR / AFTER THE FINISH

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: First win. I kept the receipt. Proof you were here before anybody knew your name.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: There is a spare bay with your name on it. Use the garage. Build carefully. We have a long week ahead.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: Margaret Street is awake now. Everybody heard about your first run.

lines.speaker: jade
lines.text: Jade Sloane. I put on Afterhours. Win tonight and I can put you in front of people with real money.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: People are not a shortcut, Jade. Let the driver earn the street.

lines.speaker: jade
lines.text: Clean finish. You have a face people will remember.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: She means a face she can put on a poster. Keep your name. We will handle the rest.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: No pack tonight. Just the river and the clock. It is easy to borrow courage from another car.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: Bring it home under the target. We need precision before we need more power.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: And if the run goes wrong, reset. Nobody earns respect by pretending they cannot learn.

bushnell_clock_after.title: THE QUIET TEST / AFTER THE FINISH

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: That is control. The kind that still works when nobody is watching.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: Inez called from the coast. Apparently your quiet little run was not so quiet.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: North Country Collective is not a sponsor. It is the people who keep these cars running.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: Two laps with the locals. Show them you belong here.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I used to run these streets with Inez. Before a contract taught us to keep score against each other.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: You earned a crew tonight. Not followers. People who will help you push a dead car home.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Remember the difference. Jade will offer you plenty of the other kind.

lines.speaker: jade
lines.text: Afterhours has a lease rescue program. One exclusive driver agreement. The garage could stop worrying.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: And every driver in the building would owe you a cut. We have read your contracts.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: Leave the paperwork here. We have a Saranac run to win.

columbus_sprint_after.title: SOUTH OF THE RIVER / AFTER THE FINISH

lines.speaker: jade
lines.text: You do not have to answer tonight. The offer will still be here when the rent is due.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: So will we. There is another way through this.

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: You are the new name in Mara's garage. I am Inez. She probably told you I left.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I told them we stopped racing together.

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: Then ask her why. First, take the northern run. I want to see whether the stories match the driving.

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: They match. Come find me when you have earned the downtown crown.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: She sounded like she wanted you to win. Mara went quiet when I said that.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: The landlord sent the final notice. Mara put it under the parts catalogue like that could make it disappear.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Three laps. This purse keeps the lights on long enough to reach the final.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: The garage is not yours to carry alone. But tonight, we could use your help.

downtown_endurance_after.title: KEEP THE LIGHTS ON / AFTER THE FINISH

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: The power stays on. Thank you. That is more than a result on a board.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: Now stop looking at the notice. We still have a crown to chase.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Before I put the Collective behind you, we run one on one.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Inez and I signed with Afterhours years ago. When the team split, I blamed her for leaving me with the debt.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I never asked what it cost her to leave. That is a mistake I will not make with you.

capitol_duel_after.title: NO ROOM TO HIDE / AFTER THE FINISH

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: You beat me straight. The Collective is yours to represent.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: Then let us make sure the whole city sees it.

lines.speaker: jade
lines.text: Downtown final. Win this and Afterhours can make the garage problem disappear tonight.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: No signature. No borrowed name. We race for the purse.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: You came here looking for a place, {driver}. Tonight you get to keep it.

capitol_crown_after.title: CROWN OF PLATTSBURGH / AFTER THE FINISH

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Downtown is yours. We can cover the overdue rent. We still need a future.

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: I have a way to give you one. Bring your crew south. This time, Mara, come with them.

lines.speaker: jade
lines.text: The coast does not owe you the same welcome. We will talk again.

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: The coast opens up. So do your mistakes. Fast roads ask for patience.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Inez. I should have called.

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: You are here now. Let the driver take Southbound. We can talk while they make the introduction.

founders_entry_after.title: A DIFFERENT RHYTHM / AFTER THE FINISH

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: Good introduction. The Lake Ghosts will give you a fair run.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: Mara and Inez are still talking. Nobody has walked away. That is progress.

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: Lake Ghosts started with three cars and a toolbox. We race so everybody gets another night on the road.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: Sounds familiar.

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: It should. Mara taught me that part. Show the coast the same respect you showed downtown.

pitkin_dash_after.title: GHOSTS ON THE LAKE / AFTER THE FINISH

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: The crew likes you. More importantly, they trust your line.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I recognize what you built here, Inez. I should have seen it sooner.

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: My Afterhours contract did not end when I left. I paid for two years after that last race.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I thought you left me holding everything.

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: They told us different stories. Beat the coastal clock. Then we stop letting them tell this one.

river_clock_after.title: WHAT THE CLOCK KEEPS / AFTER THE FINISH

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I am sorry. For the silence. For making it easier to believe we were enemies.

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: Apology accepted. Now let us do something useful with the years we have left.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: Two crews in one garage. We are going to need more mugs.

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: The Midnight circuit will show the coast we are working together.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: No team orders. Everyone gets a fair race. That is what this was supposed to be.

main_street_circuit_after.title: TWO CREWS, ONE NIGHT / AFTER THE FINISH

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: The Ghosts and the Collective can fill a grid without asking Jade for a single invitation.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: Then why not put on our own final? City to coast. Everybody welcome.

lines.speaker: jade
lines.text: Your independent final needs a prize pool. My events already have one. There is room for you if you stop this.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: We are not shutting anybody out. We are opening another door.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: Night Shift pays the first share. One race at a time. We can do this without a contract.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: First share is in. The crews are matching it. They want this race as much as we do.

lines.speaker: jade
lines.text: Be careful what you promise people. They will remember if you fail.

lines.speaker: jade
lines.text: Last offer. Your name on an Afterhours car. A guaranteed seat. No more worrying about that garage.

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: A seat is not the same thing as a home.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: This is your line, {driver}. Race Lake Road Rush. Let the finish be your answer.

silver_lane_rush_after.title: NOT FOR SALE / AFTER THE FINISH

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: No signature. No sale. I am keeping this result next to the first one.

lines.speaker: jade
lines.text: All right. Then I will meet you on the road. No contracts. Just a race.

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: The final is funded. Tonight we prove the cars and the people can go the distance.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Three coastal laps. Keep something in reserve. A fast first lap means nothing if you never finish.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: We have a bay, a toolbox, and a city full of people who showed up. Bring it back to them.

eastside_endurance_after.title: THE LONG NIGHT / AFTER THE FINISH

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: That is endurance. The car is ready. So are you.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: One more test with Inez. Then the whole road is waiting.

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: One on one. No secret line. No magic setup. Just the road I know best.

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: I spent years believing independence meant being alone. Your crew proved otherwise.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Give them a proper run, Inez. They have earned that much.

river_duel_after.title: THE GHOST LINE / AFTER THE FINISH

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: You found your own line. That is the only one that lasts.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: City to Coast is on. Everybody is coming. Let us give them a night worth remembering.

lines.speaker: jade
lines.text: I brought a car, not a contract. If you want a place on this grid, you earn it. That was your rule.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Then welcome to the grid. Downtown to Valcour. One road, one finish.

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: Whatever happens, the race belongs to the people who built it.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: Look at the lights, {driver}. You are not arriving anymore. You are home.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: You did it. The purse covers the new lease. Mara has already started arguing about a second lift.

lines.speaker: jade
lines.text: You beat me. Keep your name. You made it worth more than anything I could have offered.

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: One city. Two crews. No locked doors.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Your name goes above the bay tonight. Not because you saved us. Because you stayed.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: First receipt. Last result. I put them both on the wall. Everything between them is yours.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: The lease is signed. The garage stays independent. Tomorrow, we open the doors.

lines.speaker: inez
lines.text: Tonight, take the coast road. No clock. No target. Just drive.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: Street Legacy complete. Come back for a better time, another build, or just another night with us.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: A result is not an ending. Come back, check the car, and find the part of the road you can improve.

lines.speaker: quinn
lines.text: We are still here. The next run is yours.
